name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.5 degrees south of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 7 visits over 29 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 18 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 34 hours starting 2025-04-29, at wavelengths from 0.74 to 1.10 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
